_doc: Glossary for translating Japanese source comments to English (TODO 1256). Use the same English word for the same Japanese word everywhere. `patterns` are fixed rewrites of whole phrases; `terms` are word-level choices; `keep` are things that are never translated. Words picked from the most frequent kanji/katakana words in the real comments (extract + count), see docs/notes/wave92.md.

patterns.note: keep the number; also in lists like "項目 55 / 56" -> "items 55 / 56"
history reference, e.g. "第 18 波 束 B" -> "wave 18 bundle B"

patterns.ja: N 回目 / 第 N 回の代理確認
patterns.en: run N / the Nth proxy verification

patterns.ja: 〜する (だ・である調の体言止め)
patterns.en: full sentences in plain present tense
patterns.note: do not mimic the Japanese sentence shape; write natural English

terms.束: bundle (a unit of parallel work in a wave)
terms.波: wave (a release cycle of work, "第 N 波" = wave N)
terms.合流: merge (the integration of bundles into main)
terms.直し: fix ("直しの Agent" = fix agent; as a noun in a review context: follow-up fix)
terms.口: entry point (the single place that does something). "ファイルの口" = file access entry point; "OS の口" = OS layer; use "gateway" only for the MCP gateway
terms.索引: index (the file/conversation search index); "索引プロセス" = index process
terms.札: badge / label (a small tag shown in the UI); for a guard marker in text use "marker"
terms.検証版: verification build (a dev instance started with --user-data-dir)
terms.捨て場: scratch area / dump (threads with no working folder, T19); keep the T19 reference
terms.無人: unattended ("無人のターン" = unattended turn, "無人の定時ジョブ" = unattended scheduled job)
terms.発言: message / utterance (a user's or AI's remark in a thread)
terms.本文: body (of a document or message); "本文検索" = full-text search
terms.拡張機能: extension (user-visible word for what the code calls a plugin; the CLI's own plugins are "CLI plugin")
terms.代理確認: proxy verification (checking the app through a duplicated DB + CDP instead of the owner)
terms.実物: the real thing / the real one (as opposed to a fake or copy); in tests "real"
terms.偽物 / 偽の: fake / spoofed (depending on context: a fake backend is "fake", a forged sender is "spoofed")
terms.一時表示: temporary view (a file opened transiently, not as a tab)
terms.ホスト / host: host (the app side that embeds a viewer)
terms.分岐: branch / fork (of a thread); "分岐" in code flow = branch
terms.畳む: fold (case folding) / collapse (UI), depending on context
terms.道具: tool / utility (a helper in scripts or code); for AI "ツール" use "tool"
terms.予約: reservation (a reserved number) / queued (a reserved message), depending on context

keep: Identifiers, file paths, command names, flags, quoted code in backticks, URLs
ARCHITECTURE / IMPLEMENTATION_BRIEF section numbers, TODO / item numbers, T-numbers (T19), P-numbers (P1)
Product and library names (Electron, CodeMirror, SQLite ...)
The word "CLI" for the agent command line tool (write "the CLI"; never the product name, see the prompt, constraint 6)
Japanese UI strings quoted from the code only when the comment is about that exact string: avoid; otherwise describe it in English or quote it in backticks and set keepJa
